verifyBehavior.notes: Operator-recorded override (2026-04-03 incident): 3691 products wrongly deactivated when verifyMethod was store-api because this site keeps ~3778 catalog_visibility=hidden archive items that Store API filters out. R2 reproduced: slug query /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?slug=swiss-30-cal-cleaning-kit returns [] (HTTP 200) while /product/swiss-30-cal-cleaning-kit/ returns HTTP 200 with full HTML — product is published but Store-API-hidden. With worker.ts L544 fix on branch fix/batch-3-runtime-bugs-2026-05-19, Store-API misses correctly fall through to Playwright, but detail-page is the conservative belt-and-suspenders choice until that fix lands on main.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of allOption (catalog-visible) = 528, matches Store API x-wp-total exactly (528). Sum of wpRestCount = 4302 (within rounding of WP REST core x-wp-total: 4306; product-sitemap multi-file sum = 4306). The 528 vs 4306 divergence is catalog_visibility filter: Store API filters to visible only; WP REST core returns ALL published products including catalog_visibility=hidden (sold-archive listings kept for SEO permalinks).

r1Divergences.verifyMethod: R1 said store-api; DB said detail-page. R2 verdict: DB wins. Reproduced the Store-API-hidden pattern: 4 of 4 sampled WP-REST-only product IDs returned empty arrays from /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?slug=<x> while /product/<x>/ returned HTTP 200 with full HTML. With the worker.ts L544 fix on this branch, store-api would now fall through to Playwright on misses, but detail-page is the safer documented operator choice for this site.
r1Divergences.catalogUrls: R1 wins on structure. DB typo /product-category/accessoriesparts/ returns HTTP 404 (confirmed); WP REST taxonomy lists 15 productive cats and R1 has all 15; the 3 small cats DB was missing (uncategorized, several-available-surplus, several-available) all return HTTP 200 with live products. Cat count sum 528 = Store API total 528 (perfect match).
r1Divergences.expectedProductCount: Both R1 (4299) and DB (4201) are stale. Current x-wp-total = 4306 (verified 2026-05-19). product-sitemap multi-file sum 1001+1000+1000+1000+306-1stylesheet = 4306. Use 4306.
r1Divergences.searchUrl: DB wins. R1 missed it. Live test /?s=husqvarna&post_type=product returns HTTP 200, title 'You searched for husqvarna - Surplus GNG', 74 product-card markers in body.
r1Divergences.paginationTemplate: R1 wins. /shop/page/2 (no slash) returns 200 but Location-redirects to /shop/page/2/ (with slash). Canonical form has trailing slash.
r1Divergences.wafType: Both equivalent. null (R1) and 'none' (DB) are operationally identical — production crawler routes on hasWaf boolean only.
